question: The Commission Strategy on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 2021-2030 includes the following initiative: ‘In 2022, the Commission will present a package to improve labour market outcomes of persons with disabilities, seeking cooperation with the European Network of Public Employment Services, social partners and organisations of persons with disabilities.
The package will support Member States in the implementation of the relevant Employment Guidelines through the European Semester.

It will provide guidance and support mutual learning on strengthening capacities of employment and integration services, promoting hiring perspectives through affirmative action and combating stereotypes, ensuring reasonable accommodation, securing health and safety at work and vocational rehabilitation schemes in case of chronic diseases or accidents, exploring quality jobs in sheltered employment, and pathways to the open labour market.

’ So far, only parts of the package have been published, namely documents on building the capacities of employment services, on promoting employment prospects through affirmative action, and on combating stereotypes. Does the Commission intend to publish the other parts of the package, i.e.

on the provision of reasonable adjustments, occupational health and safety and occupational rehabilitation systems in the event of chronic illness or accidents, research into quality jobs in sheltered workplaces, and the pathways to an open labour market? If so, when?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (3.6.2024) As announced in the 2022 joint paper presenting the Package to improve labour market outcomes of persons with disabilities (Disability Employment Package)1, the Commission has been working with stakeholders representing national, regional and sectoral levels as well as the members of the disability platform on the deliverables2.

A dedicated sub-group of the platform has provided valuable input to the drafting process including concrete examples and practices. To date, three deliverables of the Package have been published3. The other deliverables are currently in preparation.
